datePolicy: All 21 source entries explicitly record access on 2026-11-06 in retained sources.md. November 5, 2026 IRS publication and dated source editions are retained as recorded, not independently refreshed. Payment dates derive from standing IRS rules and OPM holidays, not a verified 2027 Form 1040-ES. No external research or source refresh. Copy authoring is not publication or current-law certification.
uncertainties: The $6,000 Schedule C / $2,000 eligible health allocation is illustrative, not a supplied breakdown. The $18,205–$19,281 endpoint range assumes every remaining cost is eligible; invalid deductions could increase tax further.

Actual prior-year adjusted tax and AGI are unknown. Fully withheld does not mean zero liability; salary, refund and balance due are not the benchmark. Prior return must cover 12 months and installments be timely. A safe harbor avoids penalties, not the eventual balance.

$4,650 is a rounded full-tax budgeting target, not an established safe harbor. 25% is a planning reserve, not law or a guarantee. Adjust for actual income, applicable withholding/credits and a valid annualized alternative where needed.

2027 brackets, standard deduction, QBI thresholds and SSA base are recorded as published in the retained evidence. Older 2025/2026 instructions support mechanics only. S4 health wording conflicts with S7; follow the specific Form 7206 rule that health premiums do not reduce SE tax.

No 2027 retirement-limit announcement verified in retained run; $24,500 and $72,000 are labeled 2026 proxies only. Solo sizing $41,042.47 is not a confirmed legal 2027 maximum. Plan eligibility, elections, funding deadlines, age and other deferrals need checking.

Home-office exclusive/regular and qualifying-business use, asset treatment, business allocation, health earned-income/employer-plan limits and Marketplace coordination remain fact-dependent. Do not double-count costs already included in Schedule C.

Calculator is not a filing engine or annualized-payment engine. High-income QBI, statutory minimum deduction, losses, deduction limits, other income, wages, capital gains, credits, carryovers and AMT can require a fuller calculation. Return tax tables and whole-dollar rounding may differ.
Texas no personal income tax does not establish absence of other business taxes. No definitive completed individual EFTPS shutdown date verified; no new individual enrollment recommended.

Workbook is a local package attachment only, not hosted for public download. No source workbook modification or fresh engine recalculation. Source verification results are historical retained evidence, not a new native/browser verification.

English only as assigned for a US federal/Texas-specific filer. No Chinese page, shared inventory/build/check changes, external research, accounts, contact, tax filing, payment, publication or website-repository edit.
